title: UAE’s Parkin to enter Egypt with smart parking solutions
summary: The collaboration will include the use of Parkin’s smart parking solutions and technologies across parking assets managed by the Egyptian parties

Parkin, the Dubai-listed provider of paid public parking facilities, is entering the Egyptian market.
